suggestions: I'm grateful for the stillness and peace in the early morning before Fajr to center my thoughts before a busy sprint.
I'm thankful for finally tracking down and fixing that tricky edge-case bug that had been eluding the team all week.
I'm grateful for an impromptu late-night mamak catch-up with good friends over a warm glass of teh tarik.
I'm thankful for a seamless production deployment with clean logs and zero emergency rollbacks.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a stable remote-friendly job where I can keep learning, building, and providing for my family.
I'm thankful for the soothing afternoon rain that cooled down the heat while I was deep in focus mode.
I'm grateful for a teammate who took the time to leave thoughtful, encouraging feedback on my pull request.
I'm thankful for the quiet reset that Friday prayers bring, separating a hectic workweek from a restful weekend.
I'm grateful for a simple home-cooked meal of warm rice and sambal shared with family after a long day of screen time.
I'm thankful for the clarity that comes when stepping away from the keyboard for prayer, often finding the solution right after.
I'm grateful for clear documentation and legacy code that turned out to be much easier to refactor than expected.
I'm thankful for the blessing of flexible hours that let me skip the worst of the rush-hour traffic.
I'm grateful for a quick kopi break with colleagues where we could laugh over shared debugging war stories.
I'm thankful for having good health, steady focus, and the energy to solve challenging system design problems.
I'm grateful for quiet evening moments to disconnect from all notifications and reflect on the everyday barakah in my life.
